meta.title: {{ brand.name }} | Test creation, solving and private lessons
meta.description: Teachers extract questions from scanned pages, build tests and assign them; students solve, practise and earn badges; private lessons happen over video.
meta.ogTitle: {{ brand.name }} | Test creation, solving and private lessons
meta.ogDescription: Teachers build and assign tests, students solve and improve, private lessons happen over video.

hero.eyebrow: For teachers, students and private tutors
hero.description: Teachers automatically extract questions from scanned book pages, build tests and assign them to their students. Students solve tests, practise with daily questions, and earn points and badges. When they need it, they take a private video lesson.
hero.imageAlt: A test question on a tablet, with cards for a daily streak, a leaderboard and a private lesson.

roles.title: A separate workspace for every role
roles.description: You pick your role when you sign up; menus and screens follow from it.

student.title: Student
student.description: Solve the tests assigned to you, see your result right away, and close your gaps with practice.
student.item3: Study programme and My Plan calendar
student.note: You enter your grade at sign-up and invite a parent.

teacher.title: School teacher
teacher.description: Build your question pool, create tests, and assign them to your class or selected students.
teacher.item1: Automatic question detection and AI classification
teacher.item3: Assignments with due dates and reminders
teacher.note: Teacher accounts open after administrator approval.

tutor.title: Private tutor
tutor.description: Create your profile, open your available hours, approve lesson requests, and teach on the platform.
tutor.item1: Tutor profile with subjects, fee and lesson format
tutor.item4: Video lessons and a shared whiteboard
tutor.note: Applications go live after administrator approval.

parent.title: Parent
parent.description: Follow your child's work and approve private lesson requests.
parent.note: Open your own account, then create one for your child or link your child's account.

features.title: One platform from preparation to follow-up
features.description: Preparing questions, assigning tests, solving, practising and private lessons all in one account.

detect.title: Automatic question detection
detect.text: Upload a scanned page; questions, options and passages get marked automatically. Check them and save to a test.

classify.title: AI classification
classify.text: Saved questions get a suggested subject, topic and difficulty. The teacher has the final say.

assign.title: Test creation and assignment
assign.text: Prepare the test, choose who sees it, and assign it to your class or students with a due date.

solve.title: Focused solving screen
solve.text: Time left, question map and flagging. When the test ends, results by topic are ready.

daily.title: Daily questions and practice
daily.text: A new set every day for your grade. Free practice gives instant feedback after each answer.

program.title: Programme and calendar
program.text: Create a study programme and follow it day by day in My Plan.

badges.title: Points, badges, leaderboard
badges.text: Earn points as you solve, move along badge paths, and see your place on the leaderboard.

notifications.title: Instant notifications
notifications.text: New assignments, approved lessons, earned badges and comments arrive as notifications right away.

teachers.title: Book questions in your test, without retyping
teachers.body: Drag scanned pages onto the question screen. Auto Detect finds question, option and passage regions on the page; you only check and correct them. AI suggests a subject, topic and difficulty for the questions you save.
teachers.item1: Bulk page upload by file or folder
teachers.item3: Example and worked questions, passage support
teachers.imageAlt: A scanned book page with marked question and option regions.

students.title: Solve it like an exam, see the result right away
students.body: On the solving screen you see the time left, the question map and your flagged questions at a glance. When the test ends, your score, results by topic and question-by-question review are ready. You can build a new test from your mistakes in one click.
students.item1: Assigned, in-progress and completed tests, plus Explore
students.item2: Auto-advance, flagging and clearing an answer
students.item3: Results by topic and a suggested next step
students.imageAlt: App screenshot: the test solving screen with a question, options and a question map on the right.

parents.title: See your child's progress even when you are not there
parents.body: The parent panel shows how much your child studied this week, the results of the tests they solved and the badges they earned. Private lesson requests are confirmed only after you approve them. If you have more than one child, you follow them all from one account.
parents.item1: Weekly study time and test results
parents.footnote: After signing up you can create an account for your child or link your child's account.
parents.imageAlt: Illustration: the parent panel with the child's weekly study chart, latest test result, a new badge and a private lesson request waiting for approval.

motivation.title: Make steady work visible
motivation.body: Correct answers earn points. You move step by step along badge paths, keep your streak with daily questions, and see your place on the leaderboard. The recent weeks card on your home page shows how much you studied.
motivation.item3: Total questions, correct answers and study time
motivation.imageAlt: Badges, a daily streak and a study calendar.

tutoring.title: Find your tutor and have the lesson here
tutoring.body: Filter approved tutors by subject, hourly fee, and online or in-person lessons. Pick an available time and send your request; you get a notification when the tutor approves. At lesson time, join the video lesson from your browser and work together on the shared whiteboard.
tutoring.item1: Video lessons in the browser, nothing to install
tutoring.item2: A shared drawing board throughout the lesson
tutoring.item3: All your lessons on the My Lessons screen
tutoring.footnote: Tutors state their hourly fee for information only; payment is not taken on the platform.
tutoring.imageAlt: A tutor profile and a video lesson with a shared whiteboard.

step3.title: Assign
step3.text: Assign the test to your class or selected students with a due date.

step4.title: Follow up

step3.title: Practise

step4.title: See your progress

step1.text: At sign-up, mark that you give independent private lessons.

step2.title: Fill in your profile
step2.text: Write your subjects, hourly fee and lesson format.

step3.title: Open your hours
step3.text: Add your available hours to the calendar and approve incoming requests.

step4.title: Teach
step4.text: Join the video room at lesson time and use the shared whiteboard.

subjects.title: A question pool organised by curriculum topics
subjects.description: Subject and topic classification runs from grade 2 to grade 11. Every question is tagged by subject, grade and topic; students see tests and practice questions for their grade.

pricing.question: Does {{ brand.name }} cost anything?
pricing.answer: Signing up and using it is free. The hourly fee on tutor profiles is for information only; payment is not taken on the platform.

parent.question: Is there a panel for parents?
parent.answer: Yes. Parents follow their child's work with their own account and approve private lesson requests. A parent can open their own account and create one for their child; a student can also invite a parent when signing up.

teacherApproval.question: Why doesn't my teacher account open right away?
teacherApproval.answer: Teacher and tutor applications are reviewed by a platform administrator. Until approval you see the application status screen; after approval the full teacher menu opens.

detection.question: How does question detection work?
detection.answer: You upload scanned book pages on the question screen. Auto Detect marks question, option and passage regions with an image processing model. You correct the regions and save; AI then suggests a subject, topic and difficulty for the saved questions.

access.question: How do students reach tests?
access.answer: Tests assigned by a teacher appear on the student's Tests page and home page. Tests open to their grade are listed under Explore.

video.question: What do I need for a video lesson?
video.answer: Nothing to install. When an approved lesson's time comes, join it from the My Lessons screen and allow camera and microphone access in your browser. You can draw together on the shared whiteboard during the lesson.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: The interface is available in Turkish and English. You can also switch between light and dark themes.
